expected_docs.note: The single most important document. No datasheet, no verified spec.
Needed for the drop-in vs redesign call.
What a buyer copies into their board.
What the engineer installs first; decides code portability.
Known silicon/board issues. An empty errata with no silicon is a red flag, not a clean bill.
Measured radio performance — not a certificate, a measurement.
Measured active / sleep currents, with test conditions.
How to get the first blink running.
When samples exist, how many, at what price.

note: A source document earns its place here by being the evidence behind a value in spec.json, comparison.json, sourcing.json, or compliance.md. If a value has no document here, its status cannot be 'verified'.
